description: Cooperative cancel of an in-flight invoke.call by its work_done_token; capability-gated; unknown token is an idempotent accepted:false RESULT, not an error
checked_by: framing round-trip now; cancel semantics land with the Go host RPC layer

vectors.name: response_accepted
vectors.note: sets cancel_requested; the invoke.call then completes with the cancelled result shape (method_invoke_call.json response_cancelled_as_result)

vectors.name: response_unknown_token
vectors.note: idempotent failure as a result per ADR-030 Decision 3 (comment rpc.c:3226-3228); camelCase reasonCode at result level

vectors.name: response_capability_not_negotiated
vectors.note: gated methods answer -32601 with this message form when the capability was not negotiated at connect
